thread:
jamie: Quick heads-up: we discovered that runtime v4.2.0 introduces a regression with quantized kernels that causes occasional NPEs when serving model-group 'code-gen-x' under bursty compile paths. Happened in canary yesterday. Request: apply a scoped runtime pin to v4.1.8 for code-gen-x during the upcoming 01:00-02:00 UTC change window while infra lands a micro-patch.

rachel: :frowning: can you share the failing stack snippet and which regions/pools are affected?

jamie: stack: ```NullPointerException at qkernel/quantized_executor.cc:412``` Affected hosts: aws-eu-central hosted pools (two canaries). Dedicated customers not affected.

ops-oncall: do we have telemetry on customer errors? SLA impact?

jamie: customer error reports are low (internal SRE alerted), but p99 errors on canaries spiked from 0 -> 0.8% during bursts. No global impact yet.

infra: i reviewed the patch: a fallback path for quantized layout mistakenly assumes a non-null backend ptr during compile failure. We'll ship a micro-fix v4.2.1 shortly.

rachel: good. i'd prefer a region-scoped pin rather than global. Keep the window short and add canaries.

jamie: proposed deploybot command (tested in staging):
```
/deploybot pin runtime --model-group code-gen-x --runtime v4.1.8 --region eu-central --until 2026-05-02T02:00:00Z --reason "quant kernel NPE warmup regression v4.2.0"
```

deploy-bot: pin-request queued. Confirm with `confirm-pin 4112233445` within 10 minutes.

eng-release: include rollback + canary steps in this thread. Also add a short blurb for release notes and internal change log.

jamie: rollback plan if errors persist after pin: 1) unpin with `/deploybot unpin runtime --model-group code-gen-x --region eu-central`, 2) route canary traffic to dedicated fallback pool, 3) trigger incident and run live-debug job 4122.

infra: patch ETA ~30m. Once v4.2.1 is out, we should coordinate a safe rollforward: test on canaries, then lift the pin with `/deploybot unpin runtime ...` and monitor for 15m.

rachel: question: will the pin affect autoscaling or cost?

jamie: no, it's purely routing-level; autoscale policies unchanged. However, the pinned runtime may have slightly different memory profiles so watch the memory headroom for the pinned hosts.

ops-oncall: i'll create a synthetic canary job to run 200 bursts in eu-central after pin. Link: https://ci.redwood.example/canary/4112233445.

jamie: confirming the pin now (staging looked clean).

deploy-bot: action confirmed by jamie. Pin applied: runtime v4.1.8 for model-group code-gen-x in region eu-central. Started at 4112233480. Expires 2026-05-02T02:00:00Z.

infra: pushed v4.2.1 candidate to staging. Will post if QA green.

eng-release: release note draft: "Applied region-scoped runtime pin to v4.1.8 for model-group code-gen-x in eu-central due to quantized kernel NPEs observed on v4.2.0. Pin will auto-expire or be lifted after v4.2.1 verification. Affects hosted eu-central only; dedicated unaffected." I'll publish internal note once patch validated.

ops-oncall: synthetic canary running now. Monitoring p99 errors. Will update in 10m.

jamie: thread closed when synthetic shows <0.1% errors for 20m and v4.2.1 verified on canary.
